name: trading-research
description: Trading Research department -- market intelligence, strategy, and risk analysis, matching core/capabilities/planner.js's "trading" capability catalog entry. Research/analysis only -- no execution capability (real trade execution would need financial_execution permission and a real broker connector, neither of which exist).

tools.description: Real portfolio review via core/trading/analytics.js: position value/unrealized P&L (from caller-supplied current prices -- no market data feed exists), real realized P&L via FIFO lot matching, and execution telemetry. Research/analysis only, no trade execution.
